Name: Hashem the Gizonite
Summary: Father of the sons of Hashem named among David's mighty men.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 11:34: Father of the sons of Hashem named among David's mighty men.
LifeLesson: The mention of Hashem in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
